Prepare fish-within-tank event measurements for hierarchical analysis

Source: R/hierarchical-event-model.R
aqt_hierarchical_event_prepare.Rd

Requires at least two independent experimental tanks per treatment arm and exactly two observed epochs for every scoped fish. A tank must not change assigned treatment. An event is included once per fish: studies with many events, crossovers, autoregressive designs or interference need a different statistical model.

Usage

aqt_hierarchical_event_prepare(
  epochs,
  treatment_levels = c("control", "treatment"),
  epoch_levels = c("baseline", "response")
)

Arguments

epochs

Data frame with tank_id, treatment, camera_id, track_id, epoch, value; event_id is optionally allowed but must be unique.

treatment_levels

Exactly c(control,treatment).

epoch_levels

Exactly c(baseline,response).

Value

Validated aqt_hierarchical_event_frame with factors for treatment, epoch, tank_id and fish-within-tank.
